item.title: s2Member WordPress Plugin PayPal IPN Template-Injection RCE (CVE-2026-86596)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-86596 (Wordfence advisory bbe64cd3-c5ca-4867-90de-4784510a1126). Status: Weaponized. Affects: s2Member (s2Member Framework / s2Member Pro) WordPress plugin — PayPal IPN notification handler and email-template rendering. Tags: RCE, WordPress, s2Member, plugin, PayPal-IPN, PHP, template-injection, CWE-94, webshell.
